scope: post-qualification engineering resource diagnosis and prospective runtime budgeting only
permittedDerivations: sum of the 24 observed batch wall times
whole-process residual wall time after subtracting summed batch wall time
same-algorithm same-CCD technical wall-time speedup relative to ST-direct
parallel efficiency as technical speedup divided by configured worker count
matched-worker descriptive CCD wall-time ratios without causal attribution
prospective runtime budgets for candidate B values 36, 72, 108, and 144

freshProcessBudgetModel.interpretation: planning envelopes only; the residual from one multi-batch Unity process is applied once per proposed fresh process to avoid understating startup/finalization cost

prohibitions: automatic inheritance of formal ST MIPE, power, multiplicity, or stopping rules
launching formal MQ collection or analysis
claimBoundary: All named algorithm and topology results are technical runtime diagnostics from a non-powered, non-randomized qualification. CCD differences combine topology, cache, and frequency effects and are not causal.
